tasks.short: Recruit, register and place biology students

steps.what: Participate in student recruitment and placement activities in biology
Participate in student registration with biology admissions staff

tasks.design: She still shows up for biology recruitment and placement with prospective students, and she still talks registration through with admissions staff. Nothing lists applicants, fills a registration record, or sends an offer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is being in the room and speaking with the prospective student.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool is added, because she still has to be there for recruitment, placement and registration.
tasks.still_hard: A prospective student decides during the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the student is actually asking about the biology course.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still attends recruitment, placement and registration herself.

reach.task: Take the registration she discussed with admissions staff
reach.learn: Which placement she explained in that sitting

evidence.claim: Recruitment, placement and registration still need the biology teacher in the room. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Prospective students are outside the organisation. The recruitment and placement talk is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays act_external and ungated.
Admissions staff are colleagues. The registration talk is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays write_internal and ungated.
Nothing lists applicants or fills a registration record. She still opens no list, because there is no list in this task.
unknowns: Whether admissions staff later type a registration record from what she said is unknown, and this task does not fill that record.
research_questions: How much of a recruitment day is the conversation with the prospective student, rather than paperwork someone else files?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still shows up for recruitment, placement and registration, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform administrative duties such as serving as department head
inputs: department matter raised in the meeting

tasks.design: She still performs the administrative duties of biology department head in the meeting with colleagues. Nothing lists those duties, drafts minutes, or sends a decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The duty is chairing the hour with the people in the department.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool is added, because the meeting still needs her.
tasks.still_hard: A department decision depends on what colleagues say in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the disagreement and settles the next step with the people present.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still chairs the department hour herself.

reach.task: Carry a department decision she stated in the meeting
reach.learn: What she asked the department to do next

evidence.claim: Serving as department head is the biology teacher in the meeting. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Department colleagues are inside the organisation. The duties are spoken in the meeting and no version is filed, so the step stays write_internal and ungated.
Nothing lists duties, drafts minutes, or sends a decision.
unknowns: Whether a department-head decision is later written into a standing minute is unknown, and this task does not file one.
research_questions: Which of these duties in a month are spoken in the meeting, and which are later written down by someone else?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still performs the department-head duties herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Name the topic of this outside reading assignment in biology
Compile bibliographies of suggested specialized materials from the library catalogue

loop.purpose: Suggest specialized titles for this outside reading assignment.
loop.check: A title is kept only if it resolves to a DOI or a catalogue record. Fit for the assignment is not decided here.
loop.stop: Stop when a title does not resolve, or when nothing further is suggested for this topic.
loop.why_not_simpler: A catalogue keyword search does not propose specialized materials for a course topic. The teacher still judges every title.

steps.what: Judge whether each suggested title fits these outside reading assignments
File bibliography v1 of specialized materials for the outside reading assignments

tasks.design: She writes the assignment topic in {DOCS}. A suggestion step on the library catalogue ({OTHER}) proposes specialized titles and drops any title that does not resolve to a DOI or a catalogue record. She still opens and reads every suggested title and judges whether it belongs. She then files bibliography v1 herself on the course site in {LMS}. The course site does not publish it for her. Nothing alerts. Nothing sends the list except that gated file. Showing the titles is not a saving, because she still reads them.
tasks.previous_blocker: A catalogue keyword search does not propose specialized materials, and a title that does not resolve must be dropped before she judges fit.
tasks.enabler_now: A model can suggest titles from the topic she named, and a check can drop any title that does not resolve to a DOI or a catalogue record. Fit stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to open every suggested title and decide whether this course needs it.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which specialized material this outside reading assignment actually needs.
tasks.altitude: She no longer searches the library catalogue by hand. She still names the topic, still reads every suggested title, and still files the bibliography.

reach.task: Hold the specialized titles she kept for this outside reading
reach.learn: Which titles she judged fit, not merely which ones resolved

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers for compiling bibliographies.
Invented references pass plagiarism checks unflagged.
The biology teacher still judges which specialized materials belong on the assignment. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because confirming dropped titles is inside the review in s3, already at full remaining time, and catalogue runtime is not her effort.

The only query is the assignment topic she writes in s1. The field is that topic text. She produces it, and that capture time is s1. If the topic is missing, the suggestion step does not run and she searches the library catalogue herself.
If no title resolves she does not file bibliography v1, and the low end of the range is that year, when she compiles by hand.
She still opens and reads every suggested title in s3. That reading is not a saving. A list of titles does not remove the reading.

Students are outside the organisation, so filing bibliography v1 is act_external. She files it herself on the same step, so the approval step is s4 and the approver is the biology teacher. No separate checker is added.
Nothing alerts, and nothing sends the bibliography except the file she gates in s4.
unknowns: Whether the library catalogue exposes a query for the topic text is unknown. If it does not, she searches by hand and the saving is not claimed.
research_questions: In a year when titles do resolve, how much of this task is the catalogue hunt she used to do by hand, as against naming the topic, reading titles, and filing the bibliography?

incremental.description: No separate upkeep, because checking titles sits entirely in the review she already does.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The high end is the catalogue-search share only, and only when titles resolve so she does not search by hand. The low end is a year when nothing resolves and that saving is not claimed. Reading every suggested title stays at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give public campus and community presentations

steps.what: Prepare the biology presentation for a campus or community event
Participate by giving biology presentations to the public at campus and community events

tasks.design: She still prepares her own notes and still gives the presentation to the public at the campus or community event. Nothing drafts the talk, lists events, or sends a script.
tasks.previous_blocker: The public hears her speak, and no filed version of the talk exists to send.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool is added, because the talk stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: A question from the public needs an answer she gives in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She adjusts the explanation to the people in front of her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still prepares the notes and still speaks in public.

reach.task: Hear the public explanation she gave at the event
reach.learn: How she explained the biology without reading a script

evidence.claim: Giving a presentation to the public stays with the biology teacher in the room. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The public is outside the organisation. The presentation is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays act_external and ungated.
Her notes are a draft she writes for herself. They are not a filed public version.
Nothing drafts the talk, lists events, or sends a script.
unknowns: Whether the institution later posts a recording of the talk is unknown, and this task does not file or send one.
research_questions: How often does a campus or community event require her to speak in person, rather than send a text someone else reads out?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still prepares the presentation and still gives it to the public, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is unchanged except she no longer searches the library catalogue by hand for the reading list. She still recruits, still chairs the department hour, still judges every title, still files the list, and still speaks in public.
reach: The instructional coordinator takes the registration she discussed with admissions staff.
The teaching assistant carries a department decision she stated in the meeting.
The librarian holds the specialized titles she kept after judging them.
skills_to_grow: Explain a placement in one sitting.
Judge a title by whether this course needs it, not by whether a DOI exists.
Give a public talk without reading a script.
role.ambitious_version: She still recruits, chairs the department hour, judges every title, files the list, and speaks in public, and she no longer searches the library catalogue by hand.
